build_CenterNetHead: build a CenterNetHead module with configurable cls, bbox, and share towers for object detection
create_CenterNetHead_from_config: create a CenterNetHead instance from a detectron2 config object and input shape specs
run_CenterNetHead_forward: run the CenterNetHead forward pass on multi-scale feature maps to get cls logits and bbox regression
review_Scale_module: review the Scale nn.Module that multiplies input tensors by a learnable scalar parameter
refactor_CenterNetHead_deformable: refactor the CenterNetHead to enable or disable deformable convolutions in the tower heads
